verdict.rationale: Riveter's core workflow is delegating research tasks to its built-in AI agents. You can describe a dataset in a natural-language prompt and Riveter generates the rows, enrichments fill columns using AI and web tools, and search_agent returns an AI-researched answer to a single question. Missing for 10: no evidence of a conversational in-app assistant UI, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent quality.
